description: This Java class 'TypesHelper' provides utility methods for handling data types, such as determining element sizes based on type information, converting types to TypeScript equivalents, and checking if a type is float. It appears to support type management within a larger configuration or code generation framework.

classes.name: TypesHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for type size determination, type conversion to TypeScript, and type classification (floating point or not).

methods.name: getElementSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a given type, consulting the provided ReaderState for custom structure sizes.

methods.name: convertToTs
methods.description: Converts a C/C++ type string to its TypeScript equivalent, with fallbacks and a default case.

methods.name: isFloat
methods.description: Checks whether a given type string represents a floating point type or angle type.
